ATTRIBUTE.Name: Organisation ID
ATTRIBUTE.Description: A unique identifier of the Organisation Entity.
ATTRIBUTE.Explanation: Must be unique for every Dataset. – no decision on this yet, Jarno to discuss this with WP2

Value_Specification.Comment: CAVE: During dataset creation the submitter must use the Object Attribute “alias” to state a unique identifier, however, during the submission process that repository automatically generates a unique accession ID for each submitted CMMS Entity. This accession ID will be automatically injected into the XML file using the xs:attribute “accession” by the repository during the upload process. Once a accession ID has been generated all references to a given CMMS Entity must use the xs:attribute “accession” and not the xs:attribute “alias”.

ATTRIBUTE.Name: Organisation Name
ATTRIBUTE.Description: The name of the organization as defined in the EU Funding and Tenders Portal
ATTRIBUTE.Explanation: Used to document the submitter organisation. Might be used for reporting as well. Link to the portal: https://ec.europa.eu/info/fundingtenders/opportunities/portal/screen/how-to-participate/participant-register

ATTRIBUTE.Name: Organisation PIC Code
ATTRIBUTE.Description: The 9-digit Participant Identification Code (PIC) of the submitting organization as defined in the EU Funding and Tenders Portal
ATTRIBUTE.Explanation: Used to map dataset into organisation. More robust than the organisation name. This code is available in EU portal. (Link to the portal: https://ec.europa.eu/info/fundingtenders/opportunities/portal/screen/how-to-participate/participant-register)

ATTRIBUTE.Name: Datamanager Perun Group
ATTRIBUTE.Description: A Perun group UUID identifying the group, which contains persons who are eligible to administrate this dataset in the Bigpicture repository
ATTRIBUTE.Explanation: Perun group is created in advance by the Organisation’s group administrator. The ID is not a human readable name.

ATTRIBUTE.Name: Dataset REF
ATTRIBUTE.Description: The ID of the Dataset the Organisation entity belongs to.

Value_Specification.Comment: CAVEAT: During dataset creation the xs:attribute “alias” must be used to reference a given CMMS Entity if the given CMMS Entity has not received an accession ID by the repository yet (I.e. Non-Complementary Datasets). However, during the submission process the repository will assign unique accession IDs to every CMMS Entity and internal references will be updated using the newly generated accession IDs by injecting them into the XML files. Once an accession ID has been assigned to a given CMMS Entity the xs:attribute “accession” must be used to reference the given CMMS Entity. This especially relates to Complementary Datasets, where only the xs:attribute “accession” must be used (also during data set creation) when an accession ID exists for a given CMMS Entity.
